we propose a novel algorithm that learns a model-based policy using the minimum number of state-action samples from the environment, while also learning the model of the environment.
we propose a novel method for model-based RL which leverages ideas from Bayesian optimal experiment design and is able to learn an optimal policy with significantly fewer state-action queries.

The main takeaway from our work is that

, by leveraging ideas from optimal experimental design, we can obtain a model-based RL algorithm that learns efficiently with respect to data, and can be used in a wide variety of practical applications.
